name: Athlone Windows
title: A product showcase and quote-request site for a windows and doors installer
summary: The WordPress/Elementor site for a family-run windows, doors and glass installer, showing its products and process and collecting quote and call-back requests.

metrics.label: enquiry types in the quote form
process steps shown, quote to installation

problem: A local installer that mostly won work through referrals needed a site that shows its windows and doors, explains how a job runs, and turns visitors into quote requests or call-backs.

constraints.label: Lead capture first
constraints.text: 'Get a Quote' and 'Request a Call Back' appear across the site, and a short form sorts each enquiry by type.

constraints.label: Owner-editable
constraints.text: Built on Elementor so the business can update products and copy itself.

architecture.caption: Visitors browse windows and doors, see the four-step process and reviews, and submit a short form that reaches the sales team.

sections.heading: Site and quote flow
paras: Home, About, Windows, Doors, Services, Useful Links and an FAQ on replacements. The homepage features entry doors and picture, sliding and round windows, sets out the four-step process and shows customer reviews. The quote form asks for name, phone, email and enquiry type.

outcome: The site is live, and quote and call-back requests reach the sales team already sorted by enquiry type.
